metadataRaw.title: 3 Moves for INSTANT Piriformis Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 3 easy moves you can use anytime, anywhere for instant piriformis muscle pain relief.

These exercises require no equipment and will help loosen the buttocks, glutes, and piriformis muscles. They work well for relieving symptoms caused by deep gluteal syndrome and piriformis syndrome.

Let us know how the exercises work for you!
